businesses.business: hotel and real estate holding company

primary_services.value: hotel lodging and food and beverage; apartment rentals; commercial space leasing; real estate investment

customer_segment.value: B2C: leisure hotel guests and apartment residents; B2B: business travelers, tour groups, commercial tenants

end_markets.value: hospitality; residential real estate; commercial real estate

revenue_model.value: service fees: hotel room rentals, food and beverage, and garage revenue; rental or leasing: apartment and commercial property rents

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates a hotel and multifamily and commercial properties serving guests and tenants

geography_served.value: US national: San Francisco hotel, real estate in Los Angeles area, Texas, and other US states

specialization.value: related lines: hotel operations and real estate rental, both property ownership businesses

distribution_channels.value: own locations: hotel and apartment properties; online: online travel agencies and hotel brand booking systems; direct sales: direct leasing to tenants

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: hotel and landlord rules: zoning, building codes, rent control, health and safety, labor and franchise agreements
